subtitle: A small Soullab Wisdom Circle about needs, meaning and choice
facilitation_target: 6–8 consenting adults, operational preference not Circle law
keeper_name_cited: Glenn Perry, Ph.D. — independent, unaffiliated public source reference

session_segments.title: Arrive freely
session_segments.host_prompt: You may speak, listen, write privately, or pass. Nothing requires you to disclose your history.
session_segments.boundary: Confirm privacy and recording status; this is educational, not therapy.

session_segments.title: Honor the source
session_segments.host_prompt: A symbol can invite meaning, but it cannot decide what happened to you or who you must become.
session_segments.boundary: Name Glenn Perry as an independent public reference, not as a participating host. No copyrighted reproduction.

session_segments.title: Two needs, one life
session_segments.host_prompt: One part longs for closeness; another asks for space. Can both needs deserve a hearing?
session_segments.boundary: Use a fictional example and self-authored optional reflection; no natal charts or inferred trauma.

session_segments.title: Listen and respond
session_segments.host_prompt: What surprised you when neither need had to be wrong?
session_segments.boundary: No forced turn-taking, advice, group diagnosis, or mandatory disclosure.

session_segments.title: Allow different meanings
session_segments.host_prompt: Can two people carry different meanings from the same symbol and remain free?
session_segments.boundary: Facilitator holds procedure, not interpretation. Disagreement is allowed.

session_segments.title: Keep what is yours
session_segments.host_prompt: What, if anything, would you like to carry privately from this time together?
session_segments.boundary: No automatic summary, sharing, AIN contribution, retention nudge, or obligation to return.

next_human_decision: Review exact invitation, facilitator scope, and room privacy before any date or real member outreach.
